# `silk/system/sandbox`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Constructs operating-system sandbox requests for declared tool inputs and outputs.

Import as `Sandbox` with `import silk.system.sandbox as Sandbox`.

Public declarations: 1.

<a id="request"></a>

## `request`

```silk
pub effect fn request(launcher: &Path, program: &Path, readable: &[Path], writable: &[&Path]) -> ProcessRequest
! FileError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Runs `program` sandboxed in `writable[0]`, its working directory, through
`silkc sandbox-exec` (`launcher`) on Linux, and through `sandbox-exec -p <profile>` (`launcher`)
on macOS. It reads the system's programs and libraries, `program` and `readable`, writes only
below `writable` and opens no TCP connection.


Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `wasm32-wasip1`, `wasm32-wasip2`, `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `wasm64-unknown-unknown`.
